entries.en: If you [clr 2]successfully strike a trick shot[clr 27], your[n][clr 2]Technical rank[clr 27] will increase.

entries.speaker: Technical Ranks
entries.en: When your Technical rank increases, the damage[n]you deal with a [clr 2]Technical[clr 27] hit during battle will[n]also increase. If you increase your rank even[n]higher, enemies will get [clr 2]knocked down[clr 27] as well.

entries.speaker: Technical Ranks
entries.en: You can learn trick shots by [clr 2]reading books[clr 27] and[n][clr 2]using the proper gear[clr 27]. Trick shots require a certain[n]degree of [stIcon 2][clr 26][stLabel 2][clr 27] to succeed.
